left.raw_text:
Hospitalized in an eligible medical ICU
  2

right.raw_text:
Age ≥ 18 years old at the time of hospitalization
  3

left.raw_text:
With sepsis as defined by the Sepsis-3 (2016) consensus as a known  [OR] or suspected infection  [AND] with a SOFA score of ≥2 points above baseline
  4

Received broad-spectrum antibiotics  [OR] within the last 24 hours or ordered and pending administration
  5

right.raw_text:
Able to complete enrollment within 4 hours of ICU admission for administration of the intervention within 6 hours of ICU admission
Exclusion Criteria:
  1

left.raw_text:
Inability to receive oral  [OR] or enteric fluids
  2

Immunosuppression, defined as history of solid organ transplant  [OR] or as receipt of ablative chemotherapy, [OR]  steroids at the equivalent of ≥5 mg/day prednisone, [OR]  antimetabolites, [OR]  anti-TNFα agents, [OR]  calcineurin inhibitors, [OR]  or mycophenolate
  5

right.raw_text:
Surgery  [OR] involving the intestinal lumen within 30 days or known intestinal strictures
  6

left.raw_text:
Do Not Resuscitate (DNR) [OR]  or Do Not Intubate (DNI) [OR]  status, or "no escalation of care" orders
  7

right.raw_text: Lack capacity for consent and no appropriate Legally Authorized Representative (LAR)
